stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: They take a few at once, no more.

stations.title: Payments part
stations.text: Asks about every invoice, one at a time.

stations.title: Idris
stations.say: The invoices are ready by eight.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, the payments company allows a few questions at once, and no more.
The report asks about every trade invoice, waiting four seconds for each answer.
You ask questions together, never over the limit, and only about unpaid invoices.
Now the unpaid invoices are checked a few at a time, and the list is the same as before.
Same report, same answers, and most of the night's waiting gone.
